description: This file defines the iFrameDashlet class, a custom dashboard widget for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM that displays content within an iframe. It includes configuration options, URL validation, and display rendering logic.

classes.name: iFrameDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying external content via an iframe within the SuiteCRM dashboard, extending the base Dashlet class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with provided options, setting defaults for title, URL, height, and auto-refresh.

methods.name: checkURL
methods.description: Validates the URL scheme to ensure it's either http or https; defaults to about:blank if invalid.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Generates the configuration interface for the dashlet, allowing users to modify title, URL, height, and auto-refresh settings.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Processes and saves the user-provided configuration options.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet content, embedding an iframe with the specified URL and dimensions, or an error message if URL validation fails.
